g.text: Shared workflow and unified attachments | DESIGN ONLY
FOCUSED VIEW: selected columns and relationships only.
All 33 application tables remain in the full proposed schema.
Retained: roles, blockers, subtasks, labels, watchers, planning,
notifications, activity, retries, imports and automation.
Boards filter project issues; they do not own issue rows.
Solid links summarize same-project database FKs.
Dotted link is a reservation association, not a database FK.
Detailed types, constraints and compatibility: proposed-schema.puml / proposed-design.txt.
